name: helpme-dsh
description: Delegate local Codex tasks to DeepSeek Harness through a self-describing MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate local work to DeepSeek Harness.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex App and Codex CLI to one plugin-managed DeepSeek Harness Host at 127.0.0.1:3080. Independent subagents run concurrently as sessions in the same browser UI, with named continuation, inspection, archival, and event-driven completion.
defaultPrompt: Ask DSH to inspect this workspace with the default settings.
Delegate this task to DSH in read-only mode.
Run three independent DSH tasks in parallel with non-overlapping file ownership.
Create a named DSH session and continue it later.
